commission: TRY FOREVER 1400 heartbeat replan after code-first review found a contact/motion contradiction in the new persisted-envelope integrity seam.
head: feat/heartbeat-skill-lights-20260815

selectedJudgmentJars.why: Interrupted/rejected refreshes must preserve contact while clamping all stale transition motion.
The new seam must not reintroduce the stale-motion failure already repaired in HeartbeatSceneGraph.
Repair remains source-only and must not be promoted into runtime or test claims.
The failure path must be reachable in regression source and preserve checkpoint semantics.

finding.originalPlanDefect: The first plan required storage-integrity rejection to return the exact prior frame object. That preserves contact identity but can also preserve a prior one-shot node.transitionMotion=true bit, reintroducing the stale-motion contradiction that HeartbeatSceneGraph previously repaired for interrupted refreshes.
evidence: HeartbeatSceneGraph already re-materializes preserved nodes with transitionMotion=false for rejected/incomplete refreshes.
finding.decision: Do not keep exact object identity. Preserve semantic/contact checkpoint identity instead and route storage rejection through the existing scene preservation organ so all motion is clamped and the exact storage boundary remains visible.

revisedPlan: Expose one bounded public HeartbeatSceneGraph rejection-preservation seam that delegates to its existing private preserveLastGood implementation; this is composition of the existing organ, not a neighboring controller.
Change HeartbeatPersistedEnvelopeProjection storage rejection to use that seam with the exact integrity boundary.

Strengthen regression source: storage rejection must preserve contactSha256, mark refreshInterrupted, surface the exact boundary, set transitionMotionAllowed=false, and clear every node.transitionMotion even when the prior frame had earned motion.
Correct doctrine and warm-wall wording from exact frame-reference preservation to exact visible-contact preservation with motion re-materialized off.
Re-read all source identities, then perform Regnet/Venice completion review under the same P0/phone firewall.
